card.name: Punctuation inside references and URLs
card.fires_on: Separator punctuation that sits between parts of a reference, such as the colon in a Bible verse, the period in a section or decimal number, or the & in a URL query. It fires just before the next number or parameter.

modes.label: Bible verse colon
modes.description: The colon between chapter and verse in scripture citations.

modes.label: Period in numbers or abbreviations
modes.description: A period after a section number, inside a decimal, or after an initial in a species name.

modes.label: URL and command separators
modes.description: The & or parameter name in a URL query string, or a dash in a command flag.

card.plain: It marks the dot, colon or ampersand that splits a citation, decimal or web link into parts.
